text: 安克创新公告，2026年上半年营业收入166.05亿元，同比增长29.05%；归属于上市公司股东的净利润17.02亿元，同比增长45.86%，上年同期为11.67亿元；扣除非经常性损益的净利润14.39亿元，同比增长49.65%。公司拟每10股派发现金红利人民币8元（含税），预计派发现金红利4.7亿元（含税）。
text_en: Anker Innovations announced first-half 2026 revenue of RMB 16.605 billion, up 29.05% year-on-year; net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.702 billion, up 45.86% year-on-year from RMB 1.167 billion in the prior-year period; non-GAAP net profit of RMB 1.439 billion, up 49.65%. The company plans to distribute a cash dividend of RMB 8 (tax inclusive) per 10 shares, with an estimated total payout of RMB 470 million (tax inclusive).
